title: Weak contractibility of filtered ordinary nerves
statement: Let $I$ be a small ordinary category and let $N(I)$ be its simplicial nerve, with weak contractibility as defined in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Suppose $I$ is nonempty, any two objects $i,j$ admit arrows $i\to k$ and $j\to k$ to a common object, and every parallel pair $f,g:i\to j$ is coequalized by an arrow $h:j\to k$ with $hf=hg$. Then $N(I)\to\Delta^0$ is a weak homotopy equivalence. The dual assertion holds when common successors and coequalizers are replaced by common predecessors and equalizers; thus the nerve of any small nonempty cofiltered ordinary category is weakly contractible.
